title: unearthed
text:
If love knew of the trinkets 
that soul unearthed
in this soul, the wealth,
unraveled and kissed forth,
Rejoice it would in undiminished form.

The swords and shields to treasures untold, reforged.
The rubble once fortress through which clovers and daisies now call home,
Rejoice it would in undiminished form.

But maybe it does already,
As it did always and will forever,
For only love can.
